author: CNET
description:
At the world's largest mobile show, companies from around the globe take their biggest swings. Unique smartphones, dancing humanoid robots and AI glasses are going from dream to reality. Check out the overarching trends coming out of Mobile World Congress  2026.

0:00 Welcome to MWC 2026: 100,000 People & 3,000 Exhibitors
0:14 Wild Phone Innovations: The Honor Robot Phone & FOSSIBOT Action Cam
0:39 Aesthetic & Functional Designs: Nubia Z80 Ultra & Unihertz Titan 2 Elite
1:00 The Future is Modular: Lenovo ThinkBook & TECNO Atom Phone
1:45 The Robot Invasion: Humanoid Kitchens & Autonomous Dinosaurs
2:16 Practical AI: Real-time Translation Smart Glasses
2:44 Social Media Trends: Apple's Shadow & Battery Life Comparisons
3:38 Connectivity Revolution: Wi-Fi 8, Bluetooth 7, and 6G Performance
